memories.title: Filesystem durability
memories.content: Atomic snapshots and transaction markers recover interrupted writes. Replay never blindly reruns an uncertain external tool action.

memories.title: Skill permissions
memories.content: Skill requirements describe necessary tools. The role and project permission intersection remains authoritative. Skills cannot grant shell access.

memories.title: Curated memory freshness
memories.content: Curated memory proposals require evidence and review. Source hashes detect changes; stale records are discounted during context ranking.

memories.title: Delivery conflict policy
memories.content: Git delivery uses an isolated worktree and an exact base. Preserve the canonical source branch when it has advanced.

dataset_manifest.label_scope: Primary target paths, not exhaustive relevance judgments; precision is labeled-target precision. Negative cases have no expected relevant path.

environment.environment_policy: isolated-source-v3; no inherited ORQALIS/PYTHON/PYTEST/GIT overrides; no user/system Git config; process-scoped core.autocrlf=input

limits: Reconstructed baseline, not a historical timing capture.
One frozen Orqalis corpus; not representative of every language or repository.
Read counts are Python open events, excluding Git/subprocess/kernel cache activity.
No real provider calls; token usage, autonomous task success, and model quality are unmeasured.
Latency is local warm-process wall time; no hardware resource cap is imposed.
Graph cold means parser-cache-cold rebuild after initialization, not cold OS/interpreter cache.
Context relevance counts matched graph/full-record paths; orientation and memory discovery are separately identified.

skills.note: Serialized input bytes, not disk reads or tokenizer estimates. Routing is deterministic.
